articles.title: Researchers Calculate Resonant State Of Four Atoms Appearing In Cold Atom Scattering
articles.description: Researchers have precisely calculated the properties of a near-bound state of four ultra-cold atoms, revealing a resonant structure in their interactions significantly influenced by the finite range of atomic forces.

articles.title: Superconductors’ Heat Transfer Linked To Quantum Geometry And External Fields
articles.description: Researchers have discovered that manipulating magnetic fields around a material can influence its ability to conduct heat, revealing a link between quantum geometry and thermal transport and establishing new limits for the efficiency of heat dissipation in superconducting materials.

articles.title: Acoustic Stress Modelling Delivers Stable, Long-Term Heat Predictions In Solids
articles.description: Researchers have demonstrated that a simplified model accurately predicts stable heat distribution in stressed materials, even with complex temperature-dependent behaviour, by proving the existence of a unique and exponentially stabilising solution to a related mathematical problem.
